about us

Pranamya Bhat

Texas, USA

Harini S

Tamil Nadu, India

why we made this

A lot of us grew up thinking we had to pick one: be queer, or be South Asian. Like the two didn't fit in the same body. We don't think that's true, so we built a place where they don't have to compete.

That's really it. A spot on the internet for South Asian LGBTQ+ people to find each other, read stories that sound like their own, and get actual help when they need it, no matter where in the world they've ended up.

and now for something completely unnecessary...

join us

this bit's easy, fill out the form below and we'll take it from there.

Where two worlds meet, and both are whole:

Rang Birangi (it means "colorful" in Hindi and Urdu) exists because too many of us grew up believing we had to choose: our queerness, or our culture. We refuse that false binary.

We preserve LGBTQ+ South Asian stories that might otherwise disappear, break cultural stigma through honest storytelling, and build a community where every identity is celebrated, not despite heritage, but within it.

12.6k+members worldwide
10+volunteers
100%volunteer-run, no corporate sponsors

ready when you are

use this link to join: https://forms.gle/hDfEeYURULR9GYzR6

what happens after you hit submit

You'll usually hear back in a few days with an invite to our group chats.

If modding, running events, or translating sounds like your thing, just say so on the form and we'll reach out!

partner with us

an orgisation, an artist, a brand that gets it? let's talk.

We're always open to partnerships and collaborations, whether that's another South Asian or queer organisation, an event, a grant, a media collab, or something we haven't thought of yet. If it's good for this community, we want to hear about it.

how it usually goes

Tell us who you are and what you're thinking on the form below. We'll write back, ask some questions, and figure out together whether it's a good fit.

use this link to talk partnerships: https://forms.gle/U9chisgWo1amjTSNA

collabs

good things multiply when you share them. here's who we've been getting into trouble with. tap a card — it flips (and it might celebrate a little).

photography

Bela Chauhan

tap for the story →

Photography Collaboration

Bela's lens finds the drama in a quiet moment — moody light, bold color, portraits that feel like stills from a film we didn't know we were in. We've been trading ideas (and probably too many playlists) ever since.

← back to the front
art

Shilpa Kancharla

tap for the story →

Art Collaboration

Shilpa paints the parts of South Asian queer life that don't usually make it onto a canvas — flower markets, bangles mid-laugh, hands mid-garland. Her work has become some of our favorite visual storytelling.

← back to the front
events

Queer Desi Social Club

tap for the story →

In-Person & Virtual Events

Meetups, virtual hangs, the occasional very chaotic group chat. QDSC throws the gatherings, we help spread the word — and real friendships keep coming out of these rooms.

← back to the front
craft

Stellar Blooms

tap for the story →

Pipe-Cleaner Flowers

Fuzzy pastel blooms twisted from pipe cleaners — peach, mint and lavender petals around a sunny yellow centre. Shaped by hand, so no two are alike.

DM to buy ♡

crochet & embroidery

Sahana

tap for the story →

Desi-Inspired Textile Art

Sahana makes handmade textile pieces inspired by South Asian motifs, memories, and everyday details, bringing a distinctly desi touch to crochet, embroidery, and stitchwork.
